intro: Chubby is your cosy corner of calm—high-backed, cloud-soft, and wrapped in rich upholstery with sleek leather accents. The chaise invites you to stretch out, lounge, and stay a little longer.

features.title: High-back ease with built-in support
features.text: The tall backrest is shaped to follow the natural curve of your spine, giving your upper back and shoulders a relaxed, supported feel. Under the softness, layered foam and lumbar-friendly profiling keep you comfortable through long conversations, reading sessions, or weekend naps.

features.title: Fluffy, nest-like seating
features.text: Generous foam cushioning creates that “fall-into-it” plushness while still holding its shape. The slightly voluminous proportions make the seat feel like a personal nook, making Chubby ideal when you want to curl up with a book or simply unwind at the end of the day.

features.title: Rounded armrests for gentle support
features.text: Smooth, rounded armrests are designed at just the right height to catch your elbows and forearms without digging in. Their soft curves mirror the back and seat, giving your body continuous support and reinforcing the sofa’s welcoming, cloud-like feel.

features.title: Soft curves, lifted silhouette
features.text: Chubby’s flowing lines and elevated legs combine to keep the design visually light while still feeling substantial. The ground clearance not only makes cleaning easier but also lets light travel underneath, so the sofa never feels heavy in compact rooms.

features.title: Generous ground clearance
features.text: Soft bouclé fabric adds warmth, depth, and a rich tactile feel to the seating, while the leatherette accents along the sides lend a clean, structured finish. This thoughtful contrast of textures creates a sophisticated, layered look that balances everyday durability with elevated style.

features.title: Stretch-out comfort with L-shaped chaise
features.text: The extended chaise section lets you put your feet up, change posture through the day, or share the sofa more comfortably, transforming Chubby from a single-seat retreat into a full-body lounging zone.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
